text:
erica: heads-up — planning to push SDK client v5.3 (minor semver) to prod tomorrow 10:00 PT. main changes: improved retry logic + small auth header rename. no runtime proto changes.
sam_eng: thanks — what's the rollback plan if clients start failing? :thinking:
frank_relmgr: i'll own the deploy. rollback is fast: we have a pinned previous image for the api-gateway and client-proxy. plan is 10:00 PT canary -> 10:20 grad rollout if smoke green. full rollback target < 5m if critical.
mina_qa: i'll run the smoke checklist. pointing at canary env first. will run quick compatibility test against internal services and a small set of customer proxies.
ben_sre: i'll gate network policies and watch telemetry. if error rate > 1% for 5m -> manual halt and frank will rollback. also will flip pref to serve-old if we need to fail open.
erica: client comms: lena, can we post a short note in SDK changelog + mailing list about header rename and recommended upgrade timeline? include code example.
lena_docs: yep; i'll draft tonight. suggested blurb: "v5.3: minor client improvements; auth header X-RI-Auth -> X-RI-Authorization (backwards compatible for 7 days; please upgrade)". want me to include migration snippet?
erica: include snippet and a note about how to revert to v5.2 if needed.
lena_docs: will do. pinging @partners later for marketplace listing updates.
frank_relmgr: deploy steps for tomorrow: (1) create canary release tag, (2) prod canary 10% traffic for 20m, (3) run smoke commands, (4) ramp to 100% if green. manual hold at each step.
sam_eng: smoke commands (mina pls confirm):
```
# canary smoke
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://canary.api.redwood.ai/v1/health
curl -H "X-RI-Auth: token" https://canary.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
# compatibility run (100 requests)
python tests/client_compat_run.py --endpoint canary --concurrency 5
```
mina_qa: yep that's the list. i'll post results in this thread with pass/fail and a short log paste.
ben_sre: monitoring checklist:
- request latency p90 < 120ms
- error-rate < 1%
- instance CPU < 85% for 10m
- rollout tracing (span drops) not increasing
if any fail -> alert and tag @frank_relmgr @sam_eng
frank_relmgr: rollback commands if needed:
```
# rollback proxy
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-gateway --to-revision=3
# or use deployctl
deployctl rollback apps/api-gateway --tag v5.2
```
erica: also, clients who pin header name will break; plan is to accept both headers for 7 days. frank, sam — is dual-header support already in canary image?
sam_eng: yes canary has backward-compat shim that accepts X-RI-Auth and X-RI-Authorization. production will keep shim for 7 days then remove.
mina_qa: test note: i'll verify shim behavior explicitly.
lena_docs: drafted changelog + markdown migration snippet. will post PR in docs repo now.
deploy-bot: [sched] Deployment window reserved: 2024-06-12T17:00:00Z -> 2024-06-12T18:00:00Z by frank_relmgr. Channel: #eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
erica: perfect. small ask — frank, can you call the 09:50 PT quick sync 10m before deploy to confirm readiness?
frank_relmgr: yep will do. i'll also set a canary owner (me) and a rollback owner (ben_sre) just in case.
mina_qa: i'll be on standby for smoke at 10:00 PT.
ben_sre: logging alerts hooked and runbook loaded: links/ui/runbook -> /runbooks/sdk-rollout
erica: thanks everyone — i'll send final client comms after lena posts the changelog. see you tomorrow. :rocket:
